Sofia.text: I hold the room for everyone. I have not been held in four years and I would not know how to ask.
The last client left at nine and I sat in the car for twenty minutes before I drove home.
I can read my clients in a minute and I cannot read myself at all.
I am angry with a client and that has never happened before. I am ashamed of it.
I am exhausted in a way that sleep does not touch.

Diane.text: I worked until eleven again and I have nothing to show anyone for it.
Rest feels like a moral failure. I said that out loud in a board meeting and nobody blinked.
Payroll is Friday and I have not told anyone how close it is. My jaw is tight from the moment I wake up.
I am terrified the round does not close and I am the only one who knows.
I snapped at my cofounder in front of the team and I have not apologised.
I am exhausted and I cannot stop. Those two things are the same sentence now.

Marcus.text: I can see what is wrong with anything in four seconds. It has cost me two studios.
I killed a good idea today because it was not mine and I knew I was doing it.
I am ashamed of how I spoke to the junior and I will not bring it up tomorrow.
I lied about the timeline. Again. It is easier than the conversation.
Nothing I made this year interests me. I am disgusted by all of it.

Angela.text: Everything happens for a reason. I have said that at three funerals and I believed it each time.
I am sad in a way that does not attach to anything and it has been weeks.
I have done six modalities and I am still looking for the one that lands.
I want to know why I keep choosing the same kind of person.
I am so tired of being the one who understands everybody else.
I am afraid that this is just who I am now.

Derek.text: My last three sessions were slower and nothing in the data explains it.
Pain is information. I have raced on a stress fracture and I would do it again.
My shoulders are up by my ears before I even start. My chest is tight on the warm up.
I have not slept properly in eleven days and I am still training twice a day.
I am angry all the time and there is nothing to be angry at.
I am numb through the last ten percent and I used to feel everything there.

James.text: I make the call and I sleep fine. People find that cold. It is what they hired.
Third turnaround. I know exactly what it costs and I do it anyway.
I felt nothing when we let forty people go and that is the part that frightens me.
My chest is tight in every meeting and I have told no one, including my doctor.
I am numb. I have been numb since the second company and I called it discipline.

Ana.text: I am in the middle of something and I cannot see the far side of it.
It is two in the morning and I am terrified and I do not know what of.
He died a year ago and I am worse now than I was in the first month.
I am ashamed of how long this is taking. Everyone has moved on and I have not.
I have not slept. I sat in the car outside work for half an hour.

Gordon.text: There is nothing wrong with me. Four people left in a year and each had their reasons.
I do not have a problem. I have a business that needs running.

Rosa.text: Nothing in particular. Things do not sit on me the way they used to.
